title: AgiBot World Colosseo: A Large-scale Manipulation Platform for Scalable and Intelligent Embodied Systems
abstract: arXiv:2503.06669v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We explore how scalable robot data can address real-world challenges for generalized robotic manipulation. Introducing AgiBot World, a large-scale platform comprising over 1 million trajectories across 217 tasks in five deployment scenarios, we achieve an order-of-magnitude increase in data scale compared to existing datasets. Accelerated by a standardized collection pipeline with human-in-the-loop verification, AgiBot World guarantees high-quality and diverse data distribution. It is extensible from grippers to dexterous hands and visuo-tactile sensors for fine-grained skill acquisition. Building on top of data, we introduce Genie Operator-1 (GO-1), a novel generalist policy that leverages latent action representations to maximize data utilization, demonstrating predictable performance scaling with increased data volume. translated_title: AgiBot World Colosseo：面向可扩展智能具身系统的大规模操作平台
translated_abstract: 我们探索可扩展的机器人数据如何应对通用机器人操作在现实世界中的挑战。我们推出了AgiBot World，这是一个大规模平台，包含超过100万条轨迹，涵盖五种部署场景中的217个任务，与现有数据集相比实现了数量级的数据规模提升。借助带有人类在环验证的标准化采集流水线加速，AgiBot World保证了高质量和多样化的数据分布。该平台可从夹爪扩展至灵巧手和视觉-触觉传感器，用于细粒度技能的获取。在数据的基础上，我们提出了Genie Operator-1（GO-1），这是一种新颖的通用策略，利用潜在动作表征来最大化数据利用率，展现出随数据量增加而可预测的性能扩展。在我们的数据集上预训练的策略相比在其他数据集上训练的策略平均性能提升30%。
tldr: AgiBot World是一个包含超过100万条轨迹、覆盖217个任务的大规模机器人操作数据平台，配合利用潜在动作表征的通用策略GO-1，实现了数量级的数据规模提升和平均30%的性能改进。
en_tdlr: AgiBot World is a large-scale robot manipulation platform with over 1 million trajectories across 217 tasks, which, combined with GO-1—a generalist policy leveraging latent action representations—achieves an order-of-magnitude data scale increase and a 30% average performance improvement.
